assumption_ledger.note: Exact extent of schema drift between translator and legacy parser is unknown until RN-101 audit completes
Kill switch infrastructure availability for RN-103 dashboard gating not confirmed
Canary environment availability for RN-103 validation before RN-104 not confirmed

dependency_notes.reason: Schema drift must be audited before fixtures can be backfilled to reflect the correct schema
Dashboard summary consumes step-id schema and must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema
Runbook only stabilizes after rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report identifying differences between translator output and legacy parser expectations
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator schema drift before removing the legacy parser shim. This establishes the baseline schema understanding required for downstream work.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated dependency-graph fixtures that pass tests/plan_contract.py with new step ids
ordered_steps.summary: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions. Fixtures must reflect the new schema before dashboard can consume it.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature gated by kill switch, validated in canary environment
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook documenting rollout and rollback procedures
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Complete schema drift audit (RN-101) before any downstream work
Backfill fixtures (RN-102) and verify plan_contract.py passes
Keep dashboard behind kill switch (RN-103) until canary validation succeeds
primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect or unstable step ordering if schema drift is not audited and fixtures are not updated before enabling the summary
